name: Yatake Rin
source:
He is a slender, shy boy who is serious and proud.

He is very dynamic and never gives up in learning hypnosis. He has poor eyesight, probably due to his nearsightedness, and has sanpaku eyes.

Deep down, he has been in love with the heroine, Hiroko Motohashi, since he first entered the school, Scolded by the woman he loves results in an unexpected reaction from him. He now both greatly loves and hates her.

He takes revenge on her by playing rough but never truly hurting the body of the woman he loves.
